descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Make the next rally yours. Volleyball VR brings serving, receiving, setting, spiking and blocking to a beach-club world you can play with controllers or hand tracking.

GOLDEN HOUR
Discover refreshed beach characters, the rebuilt Miami Street coastal courtyard and Club Arena, and Resort Beach in daylight, at sunset or after dark. Higher jumps, improved body and hand alignment, and updated beach ambience bring fresh energy to the court.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play offline with AI teammates and opponents, or find an online match, host a room and invite friends. Choose team sizes from 1v1 to 4v4 and four difficulties: Rookie, Amateur, Pro and All-Star. Adjust assists to suit your game.

BUILD YOUR SKILLS
Work on Serve, Receive, Set, Spike, Block, Movement and Rules in seven Guided Drills. Chase personal bests in Keep-Up & Pepper, Serve & Spike Targets and Reaction Wall, or progress through the Resort Tour. Practice is also available in mixed reality.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your player and volleyball separately in Your Locker. Adjust ball size from 21 cm to a giant 150 cm, and tune movement, audio and comfort settings for your next session.

From your first serve to a hard-fought rally, there's always another reason to step onto the court.
